items.title: FTV Q3 deep dive: recurring revenue, innovation, and margin expansion drive outlook
items.summary: Industrial technology company Fortive (NYSE:FTV) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with sales up 7.8% year on year to $1.11 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.77 per share was 9.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: AMETEK Reports Soon: How Has The Stock Reacted To Past Earnings?
items.summary: AMETEK (NYSE:AME) is scheduled to report its earnings on Tuesday, November 3, 2026. The company has a market value of about $55.2 billion. Over the last twelve months it generated $7.9 billion in revenue and $2.0 billion in operating profit, with net income of $1.6 billion.
